heroTitle: Compress PDF to 100KB Without Losing Quality
heroDescription: Shrink your PDF files down to 100KB or less directly in your browser. Perfect for email attachments and fast sharing. 100% private.

sections.title: Local Compression Engine
sections.content: Our advanced WASM engine compresses your PDF locally. No file limits.

sections.title: Zero Data Retention
sections.content: Since files never leave your device, your private data remains yours alone.

sections.title: Lightning Fast 100KB
sections.content: Hit your 100KB target size in milliseconds without server delays.

faqs.q: Can I compress a 50MB PDF down to 100KB?
faqs.a: Depending on the image content, our WASM engine will heavily compress visual data and remove hidden metadata to get as close to 100KB as physically possible.
Yes. All compression happens directly inside your browser. Your PDF is never uploaded to any server.
No, vector text and fonts remain razor-sharp. Only embedded images are compressed to hit the 100KB target.
